instruction_summary: Study 002 (theory-update): fit Besley-Persson's legal-fiscal complementarity (Figure 1) by era 1975-2000/2000-2012/2012-2024 (Q1), reconcile the paper's three determinants with successor composite capacity measures Hanson-Sigman/V-Dem/mcollective16 under the 001 X0 spec (Q2), and extend DP16256's trade-tax-dependence fact to 2023 on GRD 2025 (Q3). Branch R; reuses 001's frame_update.csv read-only.

steps.description: Rebuild venv (replication venv gone) + sha256 verify all 57 staged files
steps.command: uv venv /workspace/.venv --python 3.12; uv pip install pandas numpy statsmodels pyreadstat openpyxl matplotlib scipy; sha256sum -c sha256sums.txt

steps.description: Block A gates: locate 001 frame (reuse), GRD concept check, Q2 coverage-count gate, Q1 slope-diff method choice (stacked, written before Block B)
Block B constructions 1-3: complementarity-by-era (Q1), successor reconciliation (Q2), trade-tax march (Q3); OLS+HC1; stacked slope-diff test; verdicts
Block B construction 4: figures (complementarity trajectory with Fisher 95% CI; trade-tax march vs DP16256 vintage)
Block C: findings.md, report.md, result_card.json, followup_summary.json

key_results.Q1_complementarity_trajectory: stable (common N=148; E2 slope positive -> not rotated; stacked E2-vs-E0 slope diff -0.000259, HC1 p=0.220 -> not significant)
key_results.Q1_std_slopes_r_common_pooled: E0 0.50, E1 0.64, E2 0.52 (positive & significant all eras; high half drives it, low half weaker)
key_results.Q2_R-legor_German_Scandinavian: persists on both verdicted composites (Hanson-Sigman, V-Dem property) - most durable determinant
key_results.Q2_R-war: weakens on both composites (HS p=0.089, V-Dem p=0.73)
key_results.Q2_mcollective16: not separable (coverage): merged N=63, index N=67 < 80 floor; descriptive-only (descr. war p=0.011, legal origin p=0.002/0.014)

deviations: mcollective16 graded 'not separable (coverage)': merged estimation N=63 (index non-missing set N=67, DP16256's full set) < the 001 G5 N>=80 floor; reported descriptively with N stated on every surface, per pre-declared spec II.1(2). No substitution of the coll_cap panel mean (would change the construct).

Q3 graded direction-only: GRD 2025 gives 15 trade-tax-dependent countries in 2010 vs DP16256's 7 (outside +/-3), so the reproduce-then-extend rule reports the vintage mismatch and grades the 2023 count by direction only. Pre-named outcome, not a failure; the gap is a vintage difference (every tax denominator gives 14-15 in 2010), not a concept choice.
